cohort: 30 pregnant women enrolled at Al-Karkh Materuity hospital between January and May 2019, at 23rd to 25th gestational week
finding: Vitamin B12 deficiency was significantly associated with premature delivery and lower birth weight, while high serum glucose was significantly associated with increased birth weight and C-section delivery.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was more common in women with high serum glucose (87.32%) compared to women with B12 deficiency and healthy controls.
